home.title: Welcome to Mesaas
home.intro: Three short tracks, in quick pages to read. Close it whenever you like: the guide picks up where you left off.

p1.title: It all starts with a client
p1.lead: Each client brings together a profile, brief, deliveries and a portal of their own. Mesaas revolves around them.
p1.tip: Tip: add your own Instagram as your first client. You learn the whole path before bringing in a real client.

p2.title: Create the profile
p2.lead: Only the name is required. Email, phone and fees can wait.
p2.caption: Opens your clients with the form ready to fill in. The guide picks up where you left off.

p3.title: Connect the client's Instagram
p3.lead: With the account connected, you schedule, publish and track metrics right from Mesaas. Two ways:
p3.optionNowText: Sign in with the client's account through Meta login.
p3.optionClientTitle: The client connects on their own
p3.optionClientText: Send a secure link, valid for 30 days. They connect with no password and no Mesaas login.
p3.caption: Opens the Social accounts tab of the client you created.

p4.title: Generate the Hub link
p4.lead: The Hub is your client's portal: approvals, posts and brief, with your branding. No login, no password.
p4.fine: The link's validity renews on every client visit. You can turn it off or replace it whenever you want.
p4.caption: Opens the client's Hub tab to generate and copy the link.

p5.title: First client ready
p5.lead: This is the path for every new client. Now, who works with you?

p1.title: A member is one thing, access is another
p1.memberText: The record of who works with you: job title, contract type, costs.
p1.accessText: An email invite so the person can sign in to Mesaas. Optional.
p1.fine: You can have a member without access: a freelancer you only manage, for example.

p2.title: Three access roles
p2.lead: The role defines what a person sees and does.
p2.ownerText: Everything, including plans, billing and finance.
p2.agentText: Works on deliveries and tasks. No finance.
p2.fine: You are the workspace owner. Invites go out as admin or agent.

p3.title: Add someone to the team
p3.lead: The invite lives in the member profile: create it, turn on the invite and pick the role.
p3.caption: Opens Team with the member form open.

p4.title: Day-to-day lives in Tasks
p4.lead: Hand out the work: each task has an owner and a due date, and each post has its own assignees.

p1.title: Three words explain Deliveries
p1.lead: Workflow, stages and posts. The rest follows from them.
p1.flowText: a client's work cycle, the kanban card. E.g.: September posts
p1.stagesText: the phases of the workflow; only one is active at a time
p1.postsText: the content itself; each with its own status
p1.fine: Template: the reusable recipe that creates identical workflows every month.

p2.title: Create your first workflow
p2.lead: The wizard sets everything up: pick a ready-made template, choose the client and you're done.
p2.caption: Opens the new workflow wizard in Deliveries.

p3.title: The post brings it all together
p3.lead: Inside the workflow, each post combines the media, who does the work and the caption.
p3.box: Attach images and videos, set assignees and write the caption right in the post. All in one place, ready for approval.

p4.title: Statuses tell the story
p4.lead: A post moves through statuses until it is published. And you can create your own.
p4.fine: Create custom statuses with automations: for example, notify the team when a post is approved.

p5.title: What a post needs to be scheduled
p5.lead: Mesaas checks all of this before sending to Instagram. If something is missing, the Schedule button shows what it is.
p5.checkDate: Date and time at least 10 minutes in the future
p5.checkCaption: Instagram caption written (stories don't need one)
p5.checkMedia: At least one media file within the limits
p5.limitsText: JPEG, PNG or WebP images up to 8 MB · MP4 or MOV videos from 3 to 90 s, up to 250 MB · carousels with up to 10 items

p6.title: Ready to roll
p6.lead: Client, team and deliveries: the essentials are in place. Next, explore the Calendar, Analytics and Reports.
